notes: IFRS, from the FY2025 Form 20-F (EUR). From January 2025 SAP presents interest paid in financing activities (574, added) and interest received in investing activities (420, so no longer inside OCF; the flag is null), and restated 2024 accordingly. Income taxes paid stay in operating activities.
